text: 今日は雨やし、外には行かへんわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: その話、ほんまに初耳やわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: このたこ焼き、めっちゃ熱いから気ぃつけや。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ちょっとぐらい遅れてもかまへんで。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: そのリュック、なんぼで買うたん？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 店長、明日は休みや言うてはったで。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 日曜やのに駅前にようけ人おったわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 終電逃してもうたし、しゃあないから歩いて帰ろか。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 弟やったらまだ部屋で寝とるで。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: お土産まで持ってきてくれて、ほんまおおきに。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: あかん、もうこれ以上走られへん！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ちゃうちゃう、それ俺のプリンやって！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: なんでやねん！今日日曜やんか、学校休みやろ！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: えっ、宿題まだ一個もやってへんの？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: この服ええやろ？昨日バーゲンで買うてん！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: あいつ、また来えへんのちゃうか？もう待たれへんで！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: その店のこと、うちは全然知らへんかったわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: あの映画まだ見いひんの？来週で終わってまうで。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: わし、料理なんか全然でけへんねん。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 明日は朝早いさかい、今日はもう寝るわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 先生もうすぐ来はるから、静かにしとき。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: お母さん、今日の午後って家にいてる？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: せやから言うたやん、傘持っていきって。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ほな、また明日な。気ぃつけて帰りや。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 駅から坂道ばっかりで、しんどかったわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 隣の部屋から、けったいな音がずっとすんねん。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: その牛乳、もう賞味期限切れてるからほかして。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 使い終わったハサミは引き出しになおしといてや。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 昨日の晩、ずっと雨降っとったなあ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: この自転車、去年の誕生日にもろたやつやねん。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: お前のギャグ、全然おもろないわ！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: はよせな、電車行ってまうで！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: なんやこれ、えらい重たいやんけ！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: アホちゃうか、こんな寒い日に半袖で来て！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ほんまかいな！宝くじ当たったん？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 何回言うたらわかんねん！ええ加減にしいや！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: なにしてんねん！それ塩ちゃう、砂糖や！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: いけずやなあ、ちょっとぐらい教えてくれてもええやん！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15
